missionBody:
YOUR MISSION: 
Find all the trash cans and dump them down the garbage chutes.

YOUR FIRST MISSION

COLLECT ALL TRASH
AND DROP IT IN THE CHUTE.
missionHeading:
WELCOME TO HALLWAYS

COMPLETE EACH FLOOR'S MISSION
TO UNLOCK THE ELEVATOR
AND MOVE UP.

missionBody:
MAIL DELIVERY
Find every letter and deliver it to the room on its address.

Tap a numbered door to deliver. Then return to the elevator.
Pick up the blue paint bucket. Walk through every hallway to paint its walls. Use the wall maps to find unfinished areas, then return to the elevator.

Unscheduled flames are not a team-building exercise.
Find an extinguisher. Put out every fire.
Then return to the elevator.

YOUR FACE IS REQUIRED FOR OUR RECORDS.
Find the photo station and smile for your employee ID.
One photo. Then return to the elevator.

EMPLOYEE APTITUDE TEST

Every new hire takes one. Find the terminal down the hall and pass it.

Then return to the elevator.

BREAK ROOM DIVERSION

Someone set up a shell game down the hall. Watch closely, then pick a cup.

Then return to the elevator.

BUILDING CHALLENGE

The building wants a rematch. Rock, paper, scissors -- beat it, then return to the elevator.

BUILDING CHALLENGE

Higher or lower, three correct in a row. Then return to the elevator.

BUILDING CHALLENGE

Five-Card Draw. Pair or better passes. Then return to the elevator.

BUILDING CHALLENGE

Word Assessment. Guess the 5-letter word. Then return to the elevator.

BUILDING CHALLENGE

Memory Assessment. Watch the pattern, then repeat it. Sequence length 5 to pass. Then return to the elevator.

BUILDING CHALLENGE

Strategy Assessment. Win a game of Connect Four. Then return to the elevator.

BUILDING CHALLENGE

Strategy Assessment. Win a game of Checkers. Then return to the elevator.

BUILDING CHALLENGE

Verbal Assessment. Guess the five-letter word within six tries. Then return to the elevator.
